snippet.title: [Attention Addicted NEET] English Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Attention Addicted NEET is coming to Steam!

Getting a job? No thanks. Getting attention? Yes, please.
When her younger sister cuts off her allowance, shut-in Miyu turns to social media for easy money—and becomes addicted to the attention. Follow her changing life in a visual novel with multiple endings.

Will she walk away from internet fame and finally find a job?
Wishlist now on Steam!

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5335690/?l=english
